phase_name: Rewire mint and consume to the buffer

objectives.description: pg_grant_mint buffers push_grant_issued instead of appending
pg_grant_consume buffers push_grant_consumed instead of appending
pg_grant_revoke gains explanatory comment, no logic change
Update test-please-grant.sh audit case with clean-tree assertion + flush
Update test-guard-git-push.sh wrapper success case with flush

notes: Scope hypothesis re-confirmed: exactly 2 call sites to pg_events_append_observable changed in push-grant-lib.sh (now only its own definition and the flush's internal use remain), and exactly the 2 named test assertions needed a flush inserted (grep -rn 'tail -n1.*events.jsonl' tests/ still shows exactly those 2 occurrences, post-flush). Implementation detail: the clean-tree assertion in test-please-grant.sh's audit case compares git status --porcelain -- specs (scoped to specs/, not the whole repo) before vs after the mint, rather than asserting a bare empty string, because the fixture's own .claude/ scaffold copies are untracked and would make a literal whole-repo-empty assertion always fail regardless of this fix. All 3 named suites pass except the pre-existing, unrelated 'expired grant' failure already recorded in Phase 1.
